confidence_notes: Recent local aggregates give a useful food-price baseline, but the local sample is small and hostel listings show starting prices. Hotel estimates are holistic and seasonal; cocktail and wine prices are approximate, based partly on their relationship to local beer prices.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink use Rovaniemi-specific price data. Accommodation estimates account for Lapland tourism seasonality and limited local hostel supply, without relying on a single city comparator.
